title: Little Helper
body:
## Little Helper - your pocket companion🐝
![promotional banner for the Little Helper plugin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/418d6fbc3f498fdb9c9a288497e952004c55f856.jpeg)
### Welcome to Littel  Helper!
This plugin allows tou to craft and summon miniature versions of your favorite mobs. They aren't just cute pets that follow you, they are cute pets. Each one of them carries a chest - your portable inventory and also grants you unique potion effect.  
Remember you can only have one at a time. To collect your Helper you need to right click while sneaking and if you want to open Helpers inventory you just need to right click your Helper or its chest.

### Crafting Recipe:
```
[   ] [ T ] [   ]
[ M ] [ C ] [ M ]
[   ] [ M ] [   ]

T - Totem of undying on top
C - Chest in the middle
M - "mob item" on the sides and bottom
```
### Helpers list:
Keep in mind that each mob is small, so they can only fit through 1 block. Even the big mobs like golems!
   
- **Bee**  
Item: honeycomb  
Cappacity: 18  
Effect: regeneration   

- **Chicken**  
Item: feather  
Cappacity: 27  
Effect: slow falling     

- **Fox**  
Item: sweet berries  
Cappacity: 27  
Effect: speed  

- **Iron Golem**  
Item: iron block  
Cappacity: 18  
Effect: resistance   
    
- **Snow Golem**  
Item: snow block  
Cappacity: 27  
Effect: fire resistance  
     
- **Zombie**  
Item: rotten flesh  
Cappacity: 27  
Effect: haste  

### Mob variants
The fox naturally comes in two variants, and both can be found here. The egg you get after crafting does not have an assigned variant, the variant is randomly selected when the egg is placed.


<details>
<summary>Commands</summary>

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/helper` | Opens the main GUI menu where you can choose a helper. |
| `/helper <mob>` | Gives the player an item to summon a specific helper. |
| `/helper <mob> <variant>` | Gives the player an item for a specific helper variant. |
| `/helper remove [radius]` | Removes all active helpers within the specified radius. (default 10) |
| `/helper reload` | Reloads configuration files and crafting recipes. (doesn't work on Lite version) |

Instead of /helper you can use alias /h.

</details>

### Want more?
In Lite version there are only 6 diffrent helpers, in Pro there are 21!  

<details>
<summary>All mobs</summary>

allay, armadillo, axolotl (5 variants), bee, camel, chicken, fox (2 variants), frog (3 variants), goat, iron golem, mooshroom (2 variants), ocelot, panda (7 variants), parrot (5 variants), phantom, polar bear, rabbit (7 variants), snow golem, turtle, villager, zombie

</details>


Also if you want to freely modify helper effects, chest capacity and items, the Pro version allows you to edit the config file.
